text: I build under Cracked Studio. Croom is a market whose price nobody can rig, including me.
Every market needs a price, and every price comes from someone you trust not to lie.
Synthetic markets are worse. The house generates the number you lose to.
A seed commitment only proves they did not change their mind after you bet.
Croom takes the house out. Prices come from a public randomness beacon.
Hand anyone that recipe and they get identical prices, forever, without talking to each other.
You cannot audit that conflict away. You have to remove the party.
The chain does not supply the price. It catches anyone who lies about it and takes their bond.
Somebody already lost theirs over a lie of one unit at the eighteenth decimal place.
